verdict.rationale: Linear's 'Loops' feature lets users describe a job in plain language and choose to run it on a schedule or in response to an event, which is a trigger-and-action automation mechanism for eliminating recurring manual work (docs-11, docs-36). Webhooks and the GraphQL API also enable event-driven automation for engineers building custom integrations (docs-51, docs-52). Missing for 10: no evidence of a classic conditional rule-builder UI (if-status-changes-then-action style workflow rules) beyond agent-driven Loops, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of reliability or breadth of trigger/action types.
